decisions.reason: As a visible 2023 launch that remained promoted on its own page in 2024 and fits the firm's design-led core range, management is likely to continue it rather than admit a misstep over what can still be framed as a style-led market build-up.

Because it is closely tied to the firm's core drainage business, aligns with barrier-free seamless bathroom architecture, and has been publicly supported across two years, management is very likely to keep backing it.

Although the pump-drain concept carries more uncertainty and a related earlier product was removed, the fresh 2024 launch and invested development make management more likely to persist for now than to withdraw it immediately.
